svg.aria-label: Three bar charts for four models on the triage data. Accuracy is about 92 to 94 percent for all four, including the majority-class predictor. Recall on urgent cases is zero for the majority class. ROC AUC climbs from 0.5 for the majority class to 0.64 for the rule, 0.79 for logistic regression and 0.81 for gradient boosting
